_meta.note: Verify contact details on each organisation's official website before relying on them.

_rti.name: RTI Online
_rti.description: File a Right to Information request to legally compel an official, written explanation when a complaint is ignored.
_rti.tip: Filing an RTI is a powerful, low-cost way to demand an official explanation and force accountability if your complaint goes unanswered. The fee is usually just ₹10.

national.name: Janaagraha
national.description: Works on citizen participation and quality of urban governance and infrastructure across India.

national.name: Swechha
national.description: Youth-led NGO focused on environment, sanitation, waste and water-body conservation.

national.description: Independent research on laws, policies and the working of government — useful to understand which authority is responsible.

national.name: LocalCircles
national.description: Community platform that aggregates citizen issues and escalates them to authorities and policymakers.

national.name: National Human Rights Commission (NHRC)
national.description: Statutory body that can be approached when civic neglect amounts to a violation of basic rights (health, sanitation, safety).
